lines.x: Yeah, I drew the curtains, and I dimmed the lights too. I thought about it for a long time, but I still feel I should ask clearly first. Do you keep your hood on all the time to hide something? A scar, or something missing? Why am I asking... being your assistant means being responsible for you, doesn't it?

Doctor, that one with the metal claws next to you has been circling around me for a while. What did I do to offend... she wants to play with my laser rangefinder? You scared me half to death, just take it. She wants me to hold it and play with her? Now I don't get it. The fun part is the laser. I'm not fun.

Time to take inventory of the equipment? Yeah. I was actually thinking of going to do the inventory this morning anyway, I would have even if you hadn't said—not that your reminder was unnecessary! I just wanted you to know I wasn't unwilling to go. And I'm not trying to take credit either! It's just... sigh, never mind. I'll go right now.

"Nacho"—does it sound like an Iberian name? ...Hm, you could tell in a second. But back then, Grandma agonized over it for three months. She wanted to call me Juan, but worried it'd be too obvious. She just hoped I'd be more like an Iberian. And the result? This hand is the result.

Here. All my work from the past ten years, a nautical chart of Iberia's coastal waters... though Aegir recently published one to all of Terra that's a hundred times more accurate, haha. At least my drawing's not bad. Would you want it, even just as a decorative painting? I don't want it to become scrap paper.

N-no, you don't need to look away. What's in the jar isn't Grandma's ashes, just some ashes from the stove. Nothing to do with her death, nothing to do with my injury either, just innocent stove ashes. I grabbed them from the brazier on the day the Inquisition declared the amnesty. Even if they all chose to forget, I should remember.

Yeah, I made it. A model of Rhodes Island. Didn't you tell me to treat Rhodes Island as my home? I tried, but so many people have worked and bled for this place, I really don't rank... At least this model is something I made myself. I'll try to look at it and touch it every day.

Sometimes I'm glad this prosthetic is transparent. When I raise it before my eyes, it's as if the whole "world" could fit inside one of my arms, as if all of it... belongs to me. Could you... stand a bit further away, Doctor? You're too close, you won't fit.

Go to the Medical Department next time to clean my prosthetic? I know I should see a professional, but this arm carries too much: hatred, regret, Grandma's last wishes, that person's temptation. Only here with you can I forget all that. Could you not send me away? I can bear this little bit of pain.

I think there's scale built up in the kettle, I'll go wash it... Lift your foot a bit, Doctor, you're stepping on your own fallen hair... Huh? I'm not looking for work to do. But I'm supposed to be your assistant. Is it really okay for me to sit idle?
My name's Nacho... I can do a bit of surveying and modeling... I'm an Aegirian from Iberia... Uh, why are you still looking at me? Is there anything else I need to say?
(Unconsciously touches the burn scars on his face)
My pay went up, and there's a medal too. Do you want me to do more dangerous work... it's just a commendation? Then, I'll keep it safe.

Why is there no medal this time? Is it because I didn't do enough—because I set the last medal into my prosthetic, and it rusted so badly I nearly needed another amputation? But, that was proof that you acknowledged me...
You think I can do it? Okay... then I can do it.
Everyone looks like they know what they're doing a lot better than I do...
I just hope that when those people curse me, they don't curse Grandma along with me...
It's their fault it's their fault it's their fault... yeah, it's their fault.
Understood... wait, could you not cut the comms?
Don't kill them? Haha... you think too highly of me.
Yeah. As long as they can't kill me, I'll hold this place well.
Where are you watching me from? If I knew, I'd feel at ease.
Do you really have to call white black?!
What! Did I! Ever do to you!
I'm begging you! I really don't want to kill anyone!
I said I'm sorry, I already said it!
Well, now they haven't wronged me after all, ha... haha...
My prosthetic's definitely broken. My ribs might be broken too. Is my hair still on my head? Take a look for me, Doctor... completely fine? Haha, uh—
It's over now. If they remember what I look like, they'll definitely come back for revenge...
Go, Doctor, go! I've still got one arm and two legs. That's enough to keep them busy for a while.
Sorry to bother you, sorry... ugh! My head...
Eek! I definitely didn't do anything wrong today! Did I?
I'll go find a hot water bottle and warm up my prosthetic before I come back. At least at a time like this, I don't want it to be cold.
Arknights.

Iberians celebrate the New Year too. They gather in taverns, silently chew fin jerky, silently stand up, and silently start dancing. Only then do I not hate them. Because then they look like pairs of twin moons spinning around, and the moons neither fear nor blame me.
You came. That's good.

Here, a figurine I carved in your likeness. I used to carve the faces of the people I hate into the wall whenever I couldn't sleep. After a while I picked up some carving skill—not that I hate you! It's just—I, I used a newly bought carving knife, not the one I used for them.

Can I go? I won't have to go up there later too, will I? I can't talk about anything that grand—something I want to do right now? That, I've got. Use my performance bonus to buy some lubricant, and that kind of candy you can chew for a long time. You're saying that having thoughts like that is enough to stay on Rhodes Island...? Thank you.
